phase: F14.5 — Foundation Console production-like UAT through f.shahin-ai.com tunnel (no production DNS root)

doctrine_locked.module_subdomain_mounting_rule: Each module ships behind its own subdomain (Foundation = f.shahin-ai.com). Future modules: ri/co/as/wo.shahin-ai.com.
doctrine_locked.no_angular_url_changes: Only FC_* env, tunnel/nginx route, and Keycloak client redirect/web-origin changed.

tunnel_topology.edge: Cloudflare published application route -> http://127.0.0.1:3000 (foundation-gateway on old/current build server)

fc_env_for_F14_5.FC_OIDC_ISSUER_URL: http://localhost:8180/login/realms/dogan (internal discovery; published auth_endpoint resolves to https://shahin-ai.com/login/realms/dogan/protocol/openid-connect/auth — Keycloak hostname is configured upstream of FC; FC consumes only)

keycloak_client_settings_required.verification: Issuer-side configuration is owned by host platform; FC env now points at the f.shahin-ai.com URLs and the /auth/login redirect carries redirect_uri=https%3A%2F%2Ff.shahin-ai.com%2Fauth%2Fcallback. Final SSO completion requires the realm's foundation-console client to allow that redirect — proven by Keycloak NOT rejecting the URI in pre-flight (302 issued, no client_validation_failed).

fc_sid.host_only_or_shared_subdomain: Domain attribute set to f.shahin-ai.com so the cookie is bound to the Foundation subdomain only (not promoted to the .shahin-ai.com parent — no cross-subdomain SSO leakage). Matches the doctrine cookie rule.

raw_set_cookie_excerpts_from_logout_prob: fc_sid=; Path=/; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax; Max-Age=0; Domain=f.shahin-ai.com; Secure
fc_oauth_state=; Path=/; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax; Max-Age=0; Domain=f.shahin-ai.com; Secure

GET_https_f_shahin_ai_com_config_json.no_localhost_in_browser_facing_fields: gatewayUrl + redirectUri are now https://f.shahin-ai.com — issuerUrl remains internal discovery URL (server-side, never reached by browser).

POST_https_f_shahin_ai_com_auth_dev_sess.explanation: FC_DEV_TEST_SESSION_ENABLED=false AND NODE_ENV=production -> dev-session route NOT registered. Express default 404. Gateway log line 'dev-session endpoint enabled' grep count = 0 (absent).

verifies: redirect_uri carries the production-like UAT host f.shahin-ai.com

pages_components_tested_in_this_phase.note: F14.5 is tunnel/nginx/Keycloak posture proof. Visual rendering is the F13 GREEN proof (proofs/foundation-console/F13-browser-ui-proof.json). The same approved component set rendered there is what the f.shahin-ai.com edge serves: workspace.header, workspace.sidebar, foundation.section.heading, foundation.dashboard.summary, foundation.list.simple. End-to-end authenticated render across f.shahin-ai.com requires Keycloak realm operator to confirm the foundation-console client redirect/web-origin (see keycloak_client_settings_required) — cannot be exercised from the build host without IdP login.

screenshots.explanation: End-to-end authenticated screenshots over f.shahin-ai.com require an interactive Keycloak login that this server-side proof cannot perform. Visual rendering of the same shell + components is captured in F13 at proofs/foundation-console/F13-screenshots/ (mobile-390.png, mobile-430.png, tablet-768.png, desktop-1440.png).
